# Feature: the master console on the online table page (owner request 2026-10-28)

Repository: claude-code-game-master (hub copy of the owner's laptop repo, synced by Mutagen; edit files directly with Edit/Write).
`uv run ...` commands run on the laptop automatically; run them from the repo root. Do NOT commit, push, deploy, ssh,
or touch the VPS. Do NOT edit ops/play/hub-master.md (the orchestrator updates it; report the new op's exact syntax instead).
The last commit 75f0035 added the hub master (backend/hub_master.py HubBridge, backend/screen_driver.py hub_turn/sdk_turn);
read it.

## The owner's words (voice transcript, Russian)
«Я с ним общаюсь, короче, нажимаю типа вот эту хуйню, типа поправить там html, условно, да, или еще что-нибудь. Я текста не
вижу его. Давай [хаб-]мастеру, во-первых, чтобы мотать можно вверх-вниз было, во-вторых, чтобы все, что он там пишет, любой
текст, у меня тут видно было, то есть как в обычном Claude коде, да. Типа как-нибудь прикольно.»
Today the master's text replies go only to the driver journal (contract: "Your final text reply goes only to the driver log"),
so the owner never sees what the master says or does. The feed at the bottom (#feed, 13vh, overflow hidden) shows only the
last lines and cannot be scrolled; the story (#story) is a two-column paged article with a pager (◀ 1/1 ▶).

## A. The master log: lib/screen/masterlog.py (new, stdlib)
- File <sdir>/master-log.jsonl, one JSON object per line: {"id": int (increasing), "ts": ISO UTC, "kind": str, "master":
  "sdk"|"hub"|"driver", "text": str}. Kinds: "batch" (the message the master was given: player actions and [system] notices),
  "text" (the master's own words), "tool" (a call: for Bash the command line; for other tools "Name: <input json>"),
  "result" (a tool's output; "error": true when it failed), "turn" (a turn was published: id and its first story line),
  "note" (driver events: hub did not answer / fallback / usage limit / turn timed out / paused / resting).
- append(sdir, kind, text, master, **extra): text capped (batch/text 8000 chars, tool 2000, result 2000 with a "…" marker),
  redacted (see C), thread/process-safe enough for one writer per table plus the bridge in the same process (use a lock and
  O_APPEND writes). Rotation: when the file passes 2 MB, keep the newest ~1 MB (ids keep increasing; write a temp file and
  os.replace). read(sdir, after=0, limit=300) -> entries with id > after, newest limit, oldest first; tolerate a broken line.
- A failure to log never breaks a turn.

## B. Who writes it
- Driver (backend/screen_driver.py): "batch" with the exact message sent (SDK message or hub message; never the ticket, never
  the webhook URL), every SDK provider event in _consume: "text" (full AgentEvent "text" blocks, not text_delta), "tool"
  (tool_use; for Bash show the command from the input JSON, else "Name: input"), tool results (find the AgentEvent type
  the provider yields for tool results in backend/providers/claude_sdk.py _tool_result_events) as "result", "error" events as
  "note"; "turn" when a turn was published (by either master; find where published is detected); "note" lines for hub
  failures/fallback/pause, timeouts, usage-limit rests. SDK-mode behaviour otherwise unchanged.
- Hub bridge (backend/hub_master.py): for every call that runs: "tool" (shlex-joined command, WITHOUT ticket, stdin shown as
  "<stdin: N bytes>" except for dm-screen.sh turn/panels where the JSON is fine to show truncated) and "result" (output,
  error flag for non-zero exit); refused calls as "note". New op "say <text>" (requires the current ticket, one argument or
  stdin, max 4000 chars, does not take the call lock... decide carefully; it must not run after revoke) that appends a
  "text" entry with master "hub": the hub master mirrors its own words there because the T3 thread is invisible to the VPS.
  Add "say" to the gate usage text and README; report its syntax in your result.

## C. Privacy and secrets​
- Redact before writing: the current hub ticket (bridge knows it), the webhook URL if it ever appears, and [скрыто]:
  sk-ant-..., sk-..., ghp_/github_pat_, xox?-, AIza..., AKIA..., Bearer <token​>, long hex/base64 runs (>= 40 chars) that look
  like keys (be careful not to destroy normal text or JSON), password​=[скрыто] values. Unit-test the redaction.
- The console shows the master's internals (hidden rolls, plot notes) = spoilers. Setting DM_SCREEN_MASTER_CONSOLE=1 enables
  serving it (default off). The driver always writes the log (debugging), the server serves it only when enabled. The play
  table's env will set it to 1, the demo table keeps it off: document in ops/play/table.env.example and README.
- The page must render every entry as TEXT (textContent / escaping), never as HTML: player and master text is untrusted.

## D. Server (lib/screen/server.py)
- GET /api​/master?after=<id> -> {"enabled": bool, "entries": [...]} (404 or {"enabled": false} when off; keep the existing
  host check and token rules of the other /api endpoints). Push new entries over the existing SSE stream as an event
  (e.g. "master") so the page updates live without polling; study how the server's SSE currently notices file changes and
  follow that pattern. Cheap: stat-based change detection, read only the new tail.
- Include "master_console": true/false in whatever config/state the page already receives, so the page knows whether to show
  the button.

## E. Page (lib/screen/template.html; also lib/screen/login.html untouched)
- A "Мастер" toggle button (fits the existing header/feed chrome and theme variables) opens a console panel styled like the
  Claude Code terminal: monospace, dark translucent glass, entries in order:
  "batch" as the incoming prompt ("› " + text, accent color), "text" as "⏺ " + text (normal), "tool" as "⏺ Bash(" + cmd + ")"
  (or name), "result" as "  ⎿ " + first lines (dim; long results collapsed to ~6 lines with a click to expand), "turn" as a
  small divider "── ход N опубликован ──", "note" dim/italic; a hub/sdk badge per batch so the owner sees who played. While the
  table status is "thinking", a live "✻ мастер думает…" line with an animated spinner at the bottom.
- Scroll: the panel scrolls up and down (overflow-y:auto), keeps history (last ~500 entries in the DOM, loads the last 300 on
  open), sticks to the bottom while the user is at the bottom, and shows a "↓ новое" chip when new entries arrive while the
  user scrolled up. Mouse wheel, touch and keyboard all work. Open/closed state remembered in localStorage. On phones (narrow
  or portrait) the panel is a full-height drawer with a close button; on desktop a right-side drawer over the story (~38vw)
  that does not break the act art/header layout.
- The feed (#feed/#feedlist) becomes scrollable vertically with history (keep ~200 lines), stuck to the bottom unless the
  user scrolled up; same "↓" behaviour.
- The story: the mouse wheel and a vertical swipe turn its pages (down = next page, up = previous) so "scrolling up and down"
  works on the text too; the pager stays. Do not break the existing paging, act swap, speech highlighting or keyboard use.
- No new external resources (no CDN fonts/scripts); keep the CSP-compatible inline style of the file.

## F. Tests
- tests for masterlog (append/read/after/limit/rotation/broken line/redaction), driver logging with the FakeProvider in
  tests/test_screen_driver.py (batch, text, tool, result, turn, hub fallback notes), bridge logging + "say" (ticket required,
  refused after revoke, cap), server endpoint on/off + SSE event (see tests/test_screen_server.py patterns), template checks
  (tests/test_screen_template.py style: the panel, textContent rendering, scroll CSS).
- A Playwright e2e test in tests/e2e (non-default group): open the console, see entries, scroll up, new entry -> "↓ новое";
  take screenshots desktop (1440x900) and phone (390x844) into claude-code-game-master/.playtest/console-*.png and LOOK at them (Read the PNG)
  to judge the design. Run: `DM_SCREEN_E2E=1 uv run --group e2e pytest -q tests/e2e` (screenshots are written on the laptop;
  fetch them to the hub with `on-remote --fetch <path>` to read them).
- Whole suite `uv run pytest -q` at the end (5 tests in tests/test_wizard.py::TestWizardMCPTools fail before this work:
  mcp 2.x on the laptop, already in TODO.md; anything else failing is yours).
- Mutation check: the textContent rendering (switch to innerHTML -> a test fails), redaction, and the enabled flag.


Implement all of the above. Read the existing code first (template.html, server.py SSE, driver, hub_master, tests) and match its style. Report exact suite and e2e summary lines. Do not commit.
